### <span class="imp imp-high" title="Importance 8/10" aria-label="Importance 8 of 10">8</span> Russia Shuts Down Novaya Gazeta, Last Major Independent Newspaper
Novaya Gazeta, Russia's last major independent newspaper, closed after 33 years following pressure from authorities. Staff spent final days preserving archives spanning three decades of newsroom history.

<ul class="takeaways">
<li>Closed after 33 years of operation</li>
<li>Closure announced Oct 30, 2026</li>
<li>Staff worked overnight to preserve archives, back issues, books, photographs</li>
</ul>

### <span class="imp imp-high" title="Importance 7.5/10" aria-label="Importance 7.5 of 10">7.5</span> Lebanon Faces Economic Catastrophe Following War and Years of Government Mismanagement
Lebanon's economy faces severe crisis following the March 2024 conflict and sustained fiscal mismanagement. The World Bank projects inflation will rise over 17% and economy will contract 6.4% in 2026, with approximately 80% of the population in poverty.

<ul class="takeaways">
<li>World Bank projection: inflation &gt;17%, economy contraction 6.4% in 2026</li>
<li>Grape farmer fuel prices doubled, labor costs increased 5x, crop prices fell 50% since conflict</li>
<li>Approximately 80% of Lebanon&#x27;s population in poverty</li>
<li>Conflict killed thousands, displaced hundreds of thousands; Nov 2024 ceasefire incomplete</li>
</ul>

### <span class="imp imp-high" title="Importance 7/10" aria-label="Importance 7 of 10">7</span> Spain Holds First General Strike in 14 Years Amid Housing and Social Unrest
Spain held its first general strike in 14 years on November 11, with millions of workers disrupting transport and businesses to protest housing costs and social inequality. Strike participation reached 90% in automotive, 85% in meat, and 75% in energy sectors.

<ul class="takeaways">
<li>First general strike in 14 years; held Nov 11, 2026</li>
<li>Participation: 90% automotive/ports, 85% meat, 82% waste, 75% energy</li>
<li>Average rent nearly doubled over past decade</li>
<li>Average rent in Spain nearly doubled over past decade; strike galvanized by televised eviction of 87-year-old woman</li>
</ul>
